# generate the cluster of T cells

```{r}
setwd(Outdir)
# Read the preclustered immune cells object
Indir <- "/Users/XXW004/Documents/Projects/RuizRosado/PIPseq/Results/Evaluation_V022723/CellEvaluation_Subclustering_V0803/SortedImmune_Clusters/"
scrna <- readRDS(file = paste0(Indir,"reclustered_cells_2.rds"))
scrna@meta.data%>% head()
Idents(scrna) ="cell_type"

DimPlot(scrna, split.by = "orig.ident",label = T)
# We only collect the PT cells
#CellType[CellType$cluster %in% c("1_1","0", "9","12","18", "19","3"),2] <- "PT" # "Proximal tubule"
levels(Idents(scrna) )

#Tcells <- subset(scrna, subset = Raw_cell_type == "MAC"  )
Tcells <- subset(scrna, subset = cell_type == "7: T Cells/NK Cells" |cell_type == "20:" )

# We then recluster the PT cells
# recluster the cells
Tcells <- SCTransform(Tcells, verbose = TRUE)
Tcells <- RunPCA(Tcells,npcs = 20, verbose = TRUE)

# Run harmony for the PT cells
Tcells <- RunHarmony(Tcells, 
				group.by.vars = c("orig.ident"), 
				reduction = "pca", assay.use = "SCT", reduction.save = "harmony")
Tcells <- RunUMAP(Tcells, dims = 1:20, verbose = TRUE, reduction = "harmony")
Tcells <- FindNeighbors(Tcells, dims = 1:20,  verbose = TRUE, reduction = "harmony")

Tcells<- FindClusters(Tcells,  verbose = TRUE, resolution = 0.8)
# I want to see the layer of Tcells
DefaultAssay(Tcells) <-"RNA"
Tcells <- JoinLayers(Tcells)
# Tcells <- IntegrateLayers(
#   object = Tcells, method = HarmonyIntegration,
#   orig.reduction = "pca", new.reduction = "harmony",
#   verbose = FALSE
# )
TcellsDim<- DimPlot(Tcells,label = T)
TcellsDim
ggsave(filename = "TcellsDim.pdf", plot = TcellsDim, width = 4.5, height = 4)

TcellsDimSplit<-DimPlot(Tcells, split.by = "orig.ident",label = T)
TcellsDimSplit
ggsave(filename = "TcellsDimSplit.pdf", plot = TcellsDimSplit, width = 10, height = 3)

Idents(Tcells)
saveRDS(Tcells, file = "Tcells.rds")
```

```{r}
  setwd(ImmuneCellTypeDir)
  
  # generate the dotplots
  CellTypeDotPlot<-DotPlot(Tcells, features = ImmuneDiffType[[ImmuneCellType]])
  ggsave(paste0(ImmuneCellTypeDir, ImmuneCellType,"_DotPlot.pdf"), plot = CellTypeDotPlot, height = 6, width = 6)
  # generate each feature
  #ImmuneDiffType[[ImmuneCellType]]
  for (j in ImmuneDiffType[[ImmuneCellType]]) {
    
   # j ="Il4"
       # we use this details to escape the figures that did not show up in spatial
    skip_to_next <- FALSE
   
    # Note that print(b) fails since b doesn't exist
   # LayerData(Tcells, assay = "RNA", layer = "data")[j,]
    tryCatch(
      print(LayerData(Tcells, assay = "RNA", layer = "data")[j, ]),
      error = function(e) {
        skip_to_next <<- TRUE
      }
    )
    
    if (skip_to_next) {
      next
    }
    
    FeaturePlots <-
      FeaturePlot(Tcells, features =  j, split.by = "orig.ident") + RotatedAxis()
    ggsave(
      paste0(
        ImmuneCellTypeDir,
        ImmuneCellType,
        "_",
        j,
        "_Feature_GeneMarkers_Annoatation.pdf"
      ),
      plot = FeaturePlots,
      height = 4,
      width = 14
    )
  }
  
}
```

# Generate the cell types and their markers
```{r}
# 
UpdateBiomarkerDir <- c("/Users/XXW004/Documents/Projects/RuizRosado/PIPseq/Results/Evaluation_V022723/CellEvaluation_Subclustering_V0803/TCells/Biomarkers/UpdatedBiomarkers_V1/")

setwd(UpdateBiomarkerDir)
# The marker set for T cell and NK cells
FinalMarkers <- c(
  "Cd3e","Cd4","Cd8a","Cd8b1","Ccr7", "Tcf7","Sell", ## Those are the Tissue-recirculating central memory T cells --- cluster 0
   "Cd7", "Ccl5","Cxcr3", # activated, cytotoxic CD8⁺ T cells
  "Ifng","Cd44", ## Those are the effector memory or effector CD4 T cells, effector Th1-type. ---cluster 2
  "Il17a","Rorc","Scart1", ## γδ T cells — IL-17 producing (γδ T17) / tissue-resident---cluster 3
  "Pdcd1","Pbk", "Ccna2", "Ube2c", ## progenitor-exhausted DN T cells (Pdcd1+Cxcr6+ Cd4- Cd8-) -- cluster 13
   "Klrk1","Ncr1","Nkg7","Gzmb","Prf1",## NK cell (Cytotoxic) -- cluster 4
  "Cd7", "Xcl1", ## NK cell (Immature/developing) --- cluster 6
  "Dock10","Arhgap15","Pde4b","Tnfaip3", ## Activated or metabolically active T cells, possibly tissue-resident or migrating, with stress/mitochondrial activity. -- cluster 5
   "Park7","Tsc22d3",
  ### Progenitor exhausted T cells? High mt-gene and stress/ROS markers -- cluster 12 "mt-Cytb", "mt-Nd1", "mt-Co1",
    "Il2ra", "Il7r","Thy1","Gata3", "Fosb", "Il4" #### Activated ILC2-like cells -- cluster 11 CD127(Il7r) and CD90 (Thy1) as innate lymphoid cells 

)


Tcells@meta.data %>% head()
Tcells@meta.data <- Tcells@meta.data %>%   mutate(TandNKCellAnnot = 
           case_when(SCT_snn_res.0.8 %in% c("0") ~ "Tissue-recirculating central memory T cells", 
                     SCT_snn_res.0.8 %in% c("1") ~ "Infiltrated Epithelial cells", 
                     SCT_snn_res.0.8 %in% c("2") ~ "Effector CD4 T cells, effector Th1-type", 
                     SCT_snn_res.0.8 %in% c("3") ~ "IL-17 producing gamma delta T cell",
                     SCT_snn_res.0.8 %in% c("4") ~ "NK cell (Cytotoxic)", 
                     SCT_snn_res.0.8 %in% c("5") ~ "Activated or metabolically active T cells", 
                     SCT_snn_res.0.8 %in% c("6") ~ "NK cell (Immature/developing) ", 
                     SCT_snn_res.0.8 %in% c("7") ~ "Activated, cytotoxic CD8 T cells", 
                     SCT_snn_res.0.8 %in% c("8") ~ "Highly activated CD4 T cells, multipotent effectors", 
                     SCT_snn_res.0.8 %in% c("9") ~ "Monocyte, Macrophage", 
                     SCT_snn_res.0.8 %in% c("10") ~ "Monocyte, Macrophage", 
                     SCT_snn_res.0.8 %in% c("11") ~ "Activated ILC2-like cells", 
                     SCT_snn_res.0.8 %in% c("12") ~ "Progenitor exhausted T cells", 
                     SCT_snn_res.0.8 %in% c("13") ~ "Progenitor-exhausted DN T cells"
    )) 

Idents(Tcells) <- "TandNKCellAnnot"

ggsave(filename = "TcellsDimWithAnn.pdf", plot = TcellsDimWithAnn, width = 8, height = 4)

### Lin- markers T cells, B cells, Myeloid/monocytes, Dendritic cells, Granulocyte/neutrophil, mast cells/Basophils
# ILCs should have:
# → High Il7r (CD127), Id2, Tcf7, Tox
# → Low/absent Cd3e, Cd19, Cd11b, Cd11c, Ly6g, etc.
# Cell Type	Commonly Excluded Markers (Genes / Proteins)
# T cells	CD3E, CD4, CD8A
# B cells	CD19, MS4A1 (CD20)
# NK cells	CD94 (KLRD1) (optional — sometimes included)
# Myeloid	CD14, CD16 (FCGR3A), CD11C (ITGAX)
# Dendritic / pDCs	CD123 (IL3RA), BDCA2 (CLEC4C)
# Erythroid / Others	CD34, CD94, TCRαβ, TCRγδ

ImmuneDiffType[["Cd4"]]<- c("Cd3e","Cd4","Cd27","Ptprc","Il7r","Il2ra") # CD4 Naive cells: Cd4+, CD27+, CD45RA+, CD127+, CD25-, CD45RO-


TNKcellMarkers[["Cd8"]] <- c( "Cd8a","Cd28","Sell","Ccr7" ) # CD8 Naive T cells: Cd8+, CD27+, CD28+, CD45RA+, CD62L+, CCR7+, CD45RO-
TNKcellMarkers[["Th1"]] <-c("Cd4",'Ifng','Tnf', 'Stat1', 'Stat4', 'Tbx21', 'Il12a', 'Il2', 'Lta')
TNKcellMarkers[["Th2"]] <-c("Cd4",'Il4', 'Gata3','Il2', 'Il10','Il13', 'Il25', 'Stat5a','Irf4','Stat6',  'Il5')
TNKcellMarkers[["Th17"]] <-c("Cd4",'Il17a', 'Il17f','Rorc','Tgfb1', 'Il6',  'Stat3',  'Il23a', 'Irf4', 'Maf', 'Il21', 'Il22')
TNKcellMarkers[["Treg"]] <-c("Cd4",'Foxp3',"Il2ra",'Tgfb1', 'Il10',  'Stat5a', 'Il2')
TNKcellMarkers[["Th9"]] <-c("Cd4",'Il9',"Spi1",'Stat6', 'Irf4', 'Tgfb1', 'Il4',  'Il10')
TNKcellMarkers[["Th22"]]<-c("Cd4","Il22", 'Il23a', 'Il6', 'Ahr')

TNKcellMarkers[["Activated_Tcell"]] = c("Cd3e","Cd69", "Il2ra", "Cd44")
TNKcellMarkers[["Cytotoxic_Tcell"]] = c("Cd3e","Gzmb", "Prf1", "Ifng")
TNKcellMarkers[["Naive_CD8"]] = c("Cd3e","Cd8a", "Sell", "Ccr7", "Il7r")
TNKcellMarkers[["Naive_CD4"]] = c("Cd3e","Cd4", "Sell", "Ccr7", "Il7r")
TNKcellMarkers[["CentralMemory_CD4"]] = c("Cd3e","Cd4", "Cd44", "Sell", "Ccr7", "Il7r")
TNKcellMarkers[["EffectorMemory_CD4"]] = c("Cd3e","Cd4", "Cd44", "Ccr7", "Il7r")
TNKcellMarkers[["CentralMemory_CD8"]] = c("Cd3e","Cd8a", "Cd44", "Sell", "Ccr7")
TNKcellMarkers[["EffectorMemory_CD8"]] = c("Cd3e","Cd8a", "Cd44", "Ccr7") 
TNKcellMarkers[["Progenitor_Exhausted"]] = c("Cd3e","Tcf7","Cxcr5","Slamf6","Id3","Bcl6","Pdcd1") 
TNKcellMarkers[["Terminally_exhausted"]] = c("Cd3e","Pdcd1","Havcr2","Entpd1","Tox","Prdm1","Eomes", "Cxcr6","Lag3","Tigit","Cd244") 
for (i in 1:length(TNKcellMarkers)) {
  # cell type name
  ImmuneCellType <- names(TNKcellMarkers[i])
  #ImmuneCellType <- "Mast_cells"
  # create a director for the cell type
  ImmuneCellTypeDir <- paste0(UpdateBiomarkerDir,
        ImmuneCellType,"/")
  dir.create(ImmuneCellTypeDir,showWarnings = FALSE)
  setwd(ImmuneCellTypeDir)
  
  # generate the dotplots

         size = guide_legend(title = "PercExp"))  + RotatedAxis() 
  ggsave(paste0(ImmuneCellTypeDir, ImmuneCellType,"_DotPlot.pdf"), plot = CellTypeDotPlot, height = 6, width = 9)
  # generate each feature
  #TNKcellMarkers[[ImmuneCellType]]
  for (j in TNKcellMarkers[[ImmuneCellType]]) {
    
   # j ="Il4"

    tryCatch(

    ggsave(

      ),
      plot = FeaturePlots,
      height = 4,
      width = 12

}
```

```{r}
           case_when(SCT_snn_res.0.05 %in% c("0") ~ "RecMAC", # Recruited MAC
                     SCT_snn_res.0.05 %in% c("1") ~ "ResMAC", # Resident MAC
                     SCT_snn_res.0.05 %in% c("2") ~ "B", # B Cells not the Macrophage
                 )) 
 
 # then add the PTIntegrateAnnot into the meta data of orignal
# generate the data frame for PT cell meta data
MACSubAnnotation <- Tcells@meta.data %>% dplyr::select(SCT_snn_res.0.05, MACIntegrateAnnot)

table(MACSubAnnotation$MACIntegrateAnnot)

scrna@meta.data
## add this annotation into the meta dataset
scrna@meta.data <- scrna@meta.data %>% rownames_to_column('CellID') %>% 
  left_join( MACSubAnnotation %>% rownames_to_column('CellID'))%>% 
# then add a new column that change the NA into Raw_cell_type
  # mutate(NewAnnoation = coalesce(PTIntegrateAnnot,Raw_cell_type))
  mutate(MACSub = ifelse(is.na(MACIntegrateAnnot), Raw_cell_type,MACIntegrateAnnot))
### join the meta data to meta annoation

Idents(scrna) <- scrna@meta.data$MACSub

scrna@meta.data %>% head()
```

# generate the health cluster of Myeloblast cells
Ref: https://www.nature.com/articles/s41467-023-40156-6
```{r}
MYEDir <- c("/Users/XXW004/Documents/Projects/RuizRosado/PIPseq/Results/Evaluation_V022723/CellEvaluation_Subclustering_V0803/MYE_Subclusters/")
setwd(MYEDir)
# Read the preclustered object

# We only collect the PT cells
#CellType[CellType$cluster %in% c("1_1","0", "9","12","18", "19","3"),2] <- "PT" # "Proximal tubule"

scrna @meta.data

#Tcells <- subset(scrna, subset = Raw_cell_type == "MAC"  )
Tcells <- subset(scrna, subset = Raw_cell_type == "MAC" |Raw_cell_type == "NEU" |Raw_cell_type == "B" )
Tcells@meta.data

# We then recluster the PT cells
# recluster the cells
Tcells <- SCTransform(Tcells, verbose = TRUE)
Tcells <- RunPCA(Tcells,npcs = 8, verbose = TRUE)

# Run harmony for the PT cells
Tcells <- RunHarmony(Tcells, 
				group.by.vars = c("DataSet"), 
				reduction = "pca", assay.use = "SCT", reduction.save = "harmony")
Tcells <- RunUMAP(Tcells, dims = 1:8, verbose = TRUE, reduction = "harmony")
Tcells <- FindNeighbors(Tcells, dims = 1:8,  verbose = TRUE, reduction = "harmony")

Tcells<- FindClusters(Tcells,  verbose = TRUE, resolution = 0.1)

TcellsDim<- DimPlot(Tcells,label = T)
TcellsDim
ggsave(filename = "TcellsDim.pdf", plot = TcellsDim, width = 8, height = 6)

TcellsDimSplit<-DimPlot(Tcells, split.by = "DataSet",label = T)
TcellsDimSplit
ggsave(filename = "TcellsDimDimSplit.pdf", plot = TcellsDimSplit, width = 10, height = 3)

Idents(Tcells)
```

# 2.2 Prepared cds the object
```{r}
# build cds object

Tcells_expr_matrix = GetAssayData(Tcells, slot = "counts")

# Cell meta annotation
p_data <- Tcells@meta.data 
head(p_data)

# Gene meta annotation
f_data<- data.frame(gene_short_name = row.names(Tcells), row.names = row.names(Tcells))


pre_cds <- new_cell_data_set(Tcells_expr_matrix,
                         cell_metadata = p_data,
                         gene_metadata = f_data)

pData(pre_cds) %>% colnames()

cds <- preprocess_cds(pre_cds) #标准化+PCA降维
```

```{r}
diff_pseudo_gene

# generate the heatmap for those genes

diff_pseudo_gene.matrix <- t(apply(diff_pseudo_gene.matrix,1,function(x){smooth.spline(x,df=3)$y}))
diff_pseudo_gene.matrix <- t(apply(diff_pseudo_gene.matrix,1,function(x){(x-mean(x))/sd(x)}))
rownames(diff_pseudo_gene.matrix) <- diff_pseudo_gene;

#pheatmap(diff_pseudo_gene.matrix)

# Reference: https://github.com/cole-trapnell-lab/monocle-release/issues/295
pdf("PT_pseudotime_psudotimeGenes.pdf", height = 6, width = 8)
htkm <- Heatmap(
  diff_pseudo_gene.matrix,
  name    = "z-score",

  row_names_gp  = gpar(fontsize = 6),
  km = 8,
  row_title_rot = 0,
  use_raster=TRUE,
  cluster_rows  = TRUE,
  cluster_row_slices = FALSE,
  cluster_columns   = FALSE)

print (htkm)
```
